mission.title: Senseless
mission.description: Find out why Halborn is hunting for the Oracle.

npc.say: Don't worry, I think I've got him fooled.
This place isn't as big as it looks. There are only so many places she can hide from me...
Why Svetlana? This doesn't make any sense. It just doesn't make any sense...

Uncorroborated reports suggest that Halborn met with the Machines just before he tracked down Colt. We don't know what they talked about, but it's conceivable that it has something to do with the Oracle.

Oh, it won't be easy, but it can be done, I assure you. I know Halborn very well; in fact, I've made something of a career out of staying one step ahead of him. I'd say we have a few days before we have to start worrying. I'm going to spend them familiarizing myself with the lay of the land.
It's been quite a pleasure meeting you. I'll be in touch again shortly.

phase.briefing:
Warrior, Halborn has appeared, asking questions about the Oracle. He won't say why he wants to know about her all of a sudden, but he's very insistent. We're concerned that he may have decided to make the Oracle a target.
I'm also a little worried, because he's tracked down Captain Colt, and I don't know what the captain may have told him already...

enter.say: Jeez, Colt better have kept his big mouth shut this time. Looks like they're both in there.

talk.say: What? She's an old lady who hangs out in the park sometimes and reads fortunes. Other than that, she's a real recluse. How'm I supposed to know where she is?

done.say: Hm. Might have got there just in the nick of time.

talk.say:
So, you don't know either, huh? Bah! Don't play dumb! I know she's behind all this; the old bag's had what I wanted this whole time.
Won't talk, huh? Fine, have it your way. I'll find her without your help, and you'll stay clear, if you know what's good for you.

done.say: You know, I don't think I'd just stand around there if I was you. He doesn't look too happy.

phase.briefing: {player}, we were tracking Halborn as he left the area, and now we're detecting program override activity along his path. Since he didn't get the information he wanted from us, he may have decided to start looking for the Oracle on his own. I need you to investigate, and report on his activity.

talk.say:
This...thing was here, screaming at her, demanding to know about some...some fortune-teller. I called the police, but when they got here, they just started firing indiscriminately. He hit her...
I couldn't... There just wasn't anything I could do.

done.say: Great... But is he just striking out randomly, or does he already know some of her other connections? We always knew that the Oracle contacts a lot of people. What if he's on to them somehow, and just starts killing off her whole network until she surrenders?
No more override code in the area. Looks like you got 'em all.

phase.briefing:
Operative, our sensor programs were disrupted, and that was as far as we were able to follow him. Since you report that he's already killed a bluepill, I think we have to assume that his motives in seeking the Oracle are hardly friendly.
I'm sending you to meet with Ghost. He has information that appears to be related to this situation.

enter.say:
I dunno. If there was one person in the Matrix he shouldn't try messing with, it'd probably be the Oracle.
Okay. I'm reading Ghost in there.

talk.say:
We haven't turned up any connection between the Oracle and the woman Halborn murdered. It's too early to tell if he's following some kind of information trail. We've been trying to get a message out to the Oracle, but there still hasn't been any confirmed contact with her so far.
That isn't why I called you here, though. The other wireframed man, Carlyne, just contacted us. Says he wants to help us out. We still don't know very much about this guy, so I'm sending you in to get some details.

phase.briefing: The location Carlyne gave us is marked for you, {player}. When he met with operatives recently, he hinted that he might be interested in what Halborn is after, so it's possible that he's looking for the Oracle now, too. You should not, of course, give him any information about her.

enter.say:
I figure the Oracle can probably handle a super-powered homicidal maniac coming after her, but two could be pushing it...
Got override codes and a big reading in there... Profile matches what we've got on Carlyne.

talk.say:
Welcome, welcome. I appreciate you taking the time to come see me, I really do.
I've been keeping up on our large friend's activities, and naturally I'm concerned about this latest turn of events. Halborn is a good deal less clever than he would like to think, but the code overrides he commands make him more than a match for any Machine-created program, even one as exceptional as the Oracle. To save her, you'll need someone who can stop him. I can, and I want to help you.

done.say: He seems awfully sure of himself, doesn't he?

mission.finish: I see. Thank you, {player}. I will relay that message immediately. I don't think anyone in Zion trusts that man, but if Halborn really is going after the Oracle, we're going to need all the help we can get.
